Spider Plant: The chill, low-key overachiever of the plant world 🌿✨🕷️

She doesn’t ask for much, but still gives you air-purifying magic and tons of babies. Here’s how to keep her thriving:

1.💧 Water when dry – She’s not needy. Let the topsoil dry a bit before the next watering.
2.☀️ Loves light, hates drama – Bright indirect light is her zone. Direct sun? Too intense.
3.✂️ Brown tips? No biggie – Just trim them. Usually caused by tap water or dry air.
4.🌱 Baby maker – Propagates like a pro. Just snip and root the spiderettes. Easy win.

➕Bonus tip: She’s sensitive to fluoride & salts. Use filtered water when possible! 🚿

La humedad ambiental es clave para que los Anthuriums como el Warocqueanum, luzcan en todo su esplendor. 🌿 En su hábitat natural, estas maravillosas plantas crecen rodeadas de aire constantemente húmedo. En cultivo, una humedad entre el 70 % y 85 % ayuda a prevenir deshidratación y favorece un crecimiento vigoroso. Si el ambiente es seco, apóyate en humidificadores o agrupa plantas para recrear su microclima tropical. You can use Tim’s FAST FOOD on all your potted and garden plants. It’s great for Gardenias when their leaves turn yellow. It has trace elements that help plants leaves, turn green again.

It’s suitable for plants like Succulents, Citrus and Roses. Simply sprinkle it around your plants then water in. You’ll notice a difference in days. It makes plants happy. It costs $19.99. It’s not suitable for Grevilleas and Proteas etc.
